chunks: I asked him about what the people relate: that a sealed parchment was entrusted to Umm Salamah. So he said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, ʿAlī (عليه السلام) inherited his knowledge, his weapons, and what was there. Then it passed to al-Hasan, then it passed to al-Husayn (عليه السلام). Then, when we feared that we would be overcome, he entrusted it to Umm Salamah. Then, after that, ʿAlī ibn al-Husayn (عليه السلام) took possession of it.
He said: So I said, Yes, then it passed to your father, then came to you, and after that it came to you? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ: Umm Salamah, to whom the entrusted item was given for safekeeping
key_terms.سِلَاحَهُ: his weapons, symbolizing transmitted authority and inheritance
key_terms.صَحِيفَةٌ مَخْتُومَةٌ: a sealed parchment containing entrusted material
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام, who later received it
key_terms.عِلْمَهُ: his knowledge, inherited from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How were the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم knowledge and weapons transmitted among the Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the transmission of the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم knowledge, weapons, and entrusted items through the line of the Imams عليهم السلام. It also mentions their temporary entrusting to Umm Salamah during a time of danger, affirming the continuity of divinely designated authority and inheritance within the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
